name: Azure Static Web Apps
line: Host globally distributed static sites with optional Functions APIs.

free.text: Free tier with 100 GB/month bandwidth allowance

cells.regions: Global static delivery; Functions region selected

work.math: $9 a month. 100 GB uses an unused subscription allowance. 100 minutes of local builds fit within the included compute and stated storage limits.
$9 for Standard + $0 for functions, assuming 256 MB of memory and 250 ms of run time. Unused grants: 400,000 GB-seconds and 1 million executions.
$9 for hosting + $12.41 for database compute = $21.41 subtotal. The 32 GiB disk, backup excess and database network use leave the full total unknown.
